long_biography.plain_text:
Alvén has lived outside Sweden since 1980, building experience in international pallet and logistics systems. He translated that knowledge into a nestable plastic pallet designed to improve mechanical strength while allowing stacked units to occupy less space. A European patent application identified him as both applicant and inventor, linking the technical design to his Monaco base.

His work extended beyond the physical carrier to the customer system built around it. DACA presents the design as a way to streamline pallet movements, reduce costs and limit environmental impact across distribution chains. Alvén now serves as a senior adviser to the company, bringing experience from Swedish and international markets to the continuing commercial use of the system he developed.

uncertainties.detail: The rare exact name, Swedish context, Monaco residence and matching pallet invention resolve Dan Alvén's business identity at very high confidence. Yacht sources confirm the exact Doriana vessel and its Monaco presence after the immutable relationship began, but do not publicly name Alvén as owner; the owner link therefore remains grounded in the authoritative input rather than an independent public ownership disclosure.

DACA and the immutable record use Dan Alvén, while the European patent application renders the surname as Alven. The exact product, applicant-inventor role and Monaco address show that the ASCII form belongs to the same person. The dossier preserves the accented upstream display name.

All four dimensions remain Unknown. A patent, product-development credit and senior-adviser role establish a meaningful career, but no strong source identifies company ownership, economic rights, business scale, a wealth event, family transfers or the current composition of personal assets.

The 2008 application names Alvén personally as applicant and inventor; DACA now describes him as Senior Advisor. The dossier does not infer that he founded, owns or controls DACA, or that he retains economically material patent rights.

No authoritative exact-person source located establishes Alvén's birth day, month, year, city, middle names or education. Search-service and directory entries were excluded as insufficient for proposals.

No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram, personal website, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube or TikTok account was verified. Only DACA's official company website is proposed because it publishes his exact current role and defining work.

Inventor is the only proposed approved active tag because both the patent office and DACA make invention a substantial, defining role. Packaging manufacturing is excluded because wealth creation or operational control is not established. A niche report describes repeated historic-rally participation, but no strong official evidence located makes Rallying a defining identity rather than recreational participation, so Rallying and Motorsport are omitted.

Doriana's restoration, Monaco appearances and current sale marketing are not attributed to Alvén without named evidence. A current sale listing does not by itself establish a completed ownership change, and no vessel field is proposed or altered.
